main_text.head: Doctissimo & Celeberrimo VIRO, D. ABRAHAMO HEIDANO, Lugdunensi Professori Theologo, Seniori, & Ecclesiastæ facundissimo, Socero Venerando, FRANCISCUS BURMANNUS S.
main_text.p: BElgicam afflictam, præsertim Ultrajectensem, afflictissimam; quæque afflictionis non levis pars, non æque ac pridem gratam acceptamque omnibus, rudi penicillo a me delineatam, cui, extra te, sisterem ac offerrem, Parens Venerande, vix habui. Cui non solum omnia mea debentur, præcipue in hoc communium studiorum genere; quorum, quæ mea est feli-

page.notes: The initial is a large woodcut B joined to "Elgicam" in the transcription; the reading "Belgicam" is the likely word, shown here as printed initial plus remaining letters. The catchword "feli-" is a line-end hyphenated word, kept in the text. The bottom signature mark is not present. Show-through text from the reverse page is ignored.
